nodes.long_description:
The Ultimate Bricks Breaker Experience in Virtual Reality!

Step into an immersive 3D space and rediscover the classic brick-breaking fun like never before. Casual Bricks Breaker VR brings the legendary arcade gameplay into a stunning cosmic setting, where every shot feels impactful and every bounce is a step toward mastery.

Take control of your shots with precise aiming using your controllers. Watch as your balls navigate a star-filled universe, bouncing off colorful bricks and triggering satisfying chain reactions. Whether you’re looking for a relaxing break or a strategic puzzle challenge, this game offers endless levels to test your skills.

Game Features:
Classic Gameplay, Reimagined for VR: Enjoy the familiar brick-breaking mechanics with the added depth and immersion of a virtual reality environment.

Intuitive Controller Interactions: Aim and shoot with precision using your VR controllers for a natural and engaging experience.

Stunning Cosmic Environments: Play amidst vibrant nebulae and twinkling stars, creating a truly relaxing yet captivating atmosphere.

Endless Strategic Levels: Master the angles and physics of every bounce to clear bricks more efficiently and earn higher scores.

Multiple Game Modes: Choose between Classic mode for a standard challenge or Arcade mode for a faster-paced experience.

Immersive Visuals and Sound: Experience crisp HD graphics and atmospheric audio that enhance the cosmic brick-blasting action.

nodes.short_description: Blast through bricks in a vibrant 3D cosmos! Experience the classic arcade thrill in VR with Casual Bricks Breaker VR. Aim, shoot, and watch your balls bounce off cosmic bricks in an immersive, star-filled environment. With intuitive controller-based aiming and endless levels of physics-based fun, master the cosmic blast and climb the leaderboards!

nodes.long_description: Das ultimative Bricks-Breaker-Erlebnis in Virtual Reality! Features: Klassisches Gameplay, intuitive Steuerung und wunderschöne kosmische Umgebungen.
nodes.short_description: Sprenge Steine in einem lebendigen 3D-Kosmos! Erleben Sie den klassischen Arcade-Nervenkitzel in VR. Zielen, schießen und Bälle abprallen sehen.

nodes.long_description: Trải nghiệm phá gạch đỉnh cao trong Thực tế ảo! Đặc điểm: Lối chơi cổ điển, điều khiển trực quan và môi trường vũ trụ đẹp mắt với các tinh vân.
nodes.short_description: Phá hủy những viên gạch trong vũ trụ 3D rực rỡ! Trải nghiệm cảm giác arcade cổ điển trong VR. Nhắm, bắn và xem những quả bóng nảy trong môi trường sống động.

nodes.short_description: 鮮やかな3Dコスモスでブロックを爆破！VRでクラシックなアーケードの興奮を体験。狙いを定め、発射し、没入感のある環境でボールの跳ね返りを楽しもう。
